bug_info.bug_desc: In the pre-merge code, the EDN request was computed combinationally as `edn_req = entropy_clearing_req | entropy_masking_req` and passed to the EDN CDC synchronizer. The synchronizer's `req_chk_i` input was gated by `(lc_escalate_en[0] == Off) & ~alert[1]`, so a fatal alert or life-cycle escalation could deassert `req_chk_i` while an EDN request was still pending. This allowed an in-flight request to be dropped before it received `edn_ack`, violating the EDN/push-pull handshake expectation and potentially leaving the EDN interface and CDC synchronizer in an inconsistent state.
bug_info.fix_hint: Keep the EDN request asserted until it is acknowledged instead of dropping it on alert/escalation. Add an internal request-hold register (`edn_req_hold_q`) that is set whenever any internal entropy request is active (`edn_req_int`) and cleared only when `edn_ack` is received, then drive `edn_req` from `edn_req_int | edn_req_hold_q`. Tie `req_chk_i` to 1'b1 so the synchronizer never invalidates an outstanding request. The EDN arbitration for clearing and masking ACKs can remain with clearing priority, and the now-unused escalation gating for EDN can be removed.
